Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Shake Milton?

Shake Milton is 29 years old.

Where was Shake Milton born?

Shake Milton was born in Owasso, Oklahoma.

When was Shake Milton born?

Shake Milton was born on September 26, 1996.

How tall is Shake Milton?

Shake Milton is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Shake Milton weigh?

Shake Milton weighs 205 lbs (92 kg).

Is Shake Milton in the Hall of Fame?

Shake Milton is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Shake Milton drafted?

Shake Milton was drafted by Dallas Mavericks, 2nd round (24th pick, 54th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Shake Milton play?

Shooting Guard.

What is Shake Milton's net worth?

Shake Milton has made at least $15,342,654 playing professional basketball.

How much does Shake Milton make?

Shake Milton made $5,000,000 in 2024.

How many rings does Shake Milton have?

Shake Milton has won 0 championships.

What is Shake Milton's Instagram account?

Shake Milton is on Instagram at snipershake.

What schools did Shake Milton attend?

Shake Milton attended Owasso in Owasso, Oklahoma and SMU.

What are Shake Milton's nicknames?

Protein Shake is a nickname for Shake Milton.
